meta.task: Build me a checkout page for an online store

defs.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a scrollable panel listing each cart line item with product image, name, variant/options, unit price, an editable quantity stepper, a remove button, and per-line subtotal. It lets the shopper review and adjust exactly what they are buying before paying.
defs.role: The item-level editing surface where the shopper confirms and adjusts the contents of their order, feeding quantities and prices to the Order Summary.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary & Place Order Rail
targets.description: Whenever a line quantity changes or an item is removed, emit the updated list of {itemId, unitPrice, quantity} and total item count; the Order Summary recomputes the subtotal line and re-derives tax and grand total, and if the cart becomes empty it disables the Place Order button.

defs.name: Checkout: Shipping & Contact Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a form capturing contact email/phone and full shipping address (name, street, city, state, postal code, country) plus a selectable list of shipping methods (standard/express/overnight) each showing price and delivery estimate. It collects where the order goes and how fast.
defs.role: The delivery-details collector that determines destination and shipping speed, driving shipping cost and tax in the Order Summary.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary & Place Order Rail
targets.description: When a shipping method is selected or the destination address (region/postal code/country) changes, emit the chosen method's shipping cost, the delivery estimate, and destination locale; the Order Summary updates its shipping line, recalculates region-based tax, and refreshes the grand total. Also emits address-form validity so Place Order stays disabled until required fields are valid.

defs.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a payment form with method tabs (card, PayPal, etc.), card number/expiry/CVC inputs with formatting and inline validation, a billing-address toggle (same as shipping), and a card-brand indicator. It securely captures how the shopper pays.
defs.role: The payment-capture surface that gathers and validates payment credentials, signaling readiness to the Order Summary so the order can be placed.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Summary & Place Order Rail
targets.description: Emit a payment-valid boolean and the selected payment method whenever the card fields pass/fail validation or the method changes; the Order Summary enables the Place Order button only when payment is valid and reflects the chosen method label near the button.

defs.name: Checkout: Order Summary & Place Order Rail
defs.genInstructions: Build a sticky right-side summary showing itemized subtotal, shipping cost, tax, discount, and bold grand total, a promo-code input with apply button, and a prominent Place Order button with a secure-checkout note. It aggregates all costs and finalizes the purchase.
defs.role: The financial aggregation and checkout-completion hub that totals every input from cart, shipping, and payment and lets the shopper commit the order.

effectors.name: Checkout: Cart Items Review Panel
effectors.description: Receives updated line prices, quantities, and item count on every cart edit; recomputes the subtotal, re-derives tax and grand total, and disables Place Order when the cart is empty.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping & Contact Form
effectors.description: Receives selected shipping cost, delivery estimate, destination locale, and address validity; updates the shipping line, recalculates region-based tax, refreshes the grand total, and blocks Place Order until the address is valid.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Details Form
effectors.description: Receives payment-valid state and selected method; enables the Place Order button only when payment is valid and displays the chosen method label.
